languages.text: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

text.formatted: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.
text.plain: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

text.formatted: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.
